say:1:1530772001:1.text: Yes. Ever since she heard of her beloved's death, she hasn't left this place.
say:1:1530772001:1.source_cn: 是的，自从得知她爱人的死讯，她就一直在这里。

say:2:1530772002:1.text: Come to think of it... I've been stationed here just as long.
